references.title: DWDS: Hohepriester
references.supports: The Wortzerlegung hoch Priester, for 'oberster altjüdischer Priester'; beside it Hohe Priester (Genitiv Hohen Priesters): when the adjectival first part is inflected, only the spelling apart is correct

notes.rationale: DWDS splits it hoch + Priester. Hohe shows hoch's declension stem hoh with the frozen attributive ending -e, which the shown letters tolerate (ADR 0050; the user, 2026-10-25, #1241). Held out of every Breakdown prompt's examples (#693).
